scope: Proposition 6.1 (Uniform lower comparison) of the manuscript “L1 Embeddings of Graphs of Bounded Treewidth” (preprints/L1-Embeddings-of-Graphs-of-Bounded-Treewidth-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 089 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 13276d0ab77859c5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each fixed k ≥ 2 there is a constant λk > 0 such that, for every admissible weighted graph with a tree decomposition of bag size at most k and every pair of vertices u, v, Dbag(u, v) + Danc(u, v) ≥ λkd(u, v). (6.1)
